advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Worthy Advisary: C.J. Stroud for Parker Washington.

reasons: You're 11-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 18%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 29% of the time with the first-round bye and 14% without it. You get the bye in 24% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 8 contenders (174.0 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (10th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 3rd in 2026, 3rd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 18%, 21%, 16%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 18% to 21%, and your lineup comes out 2.8 points a week ahead overall. C.J. Stroud adds 4.5 points a week for you today, but Parker Washington is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,090, get 3,928), and it helps their lineup too (+4.4 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 21% and 16% to 27% and 22%.
You have 5 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Michael Wilson is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (3.9 points a week).
